## Summary

**Problem:** Naive IndexedDB code has four correlated atomicity/race bugs: (1) transactions auto-commit when the event loop turns with no pending request, so writing across an `await` silently produces partial commits; (2) failed requests / thrown errors / explicit aborts aren't uniformly translated into an all-or-nothing rollback; (3) cursor loops that yield between `continue()` calls let the transaction die mid-iteration and observe partial data; (4) `versionchange`/`upgradeneeded` races between tabs deadlock (old connections that don't close → `blocked` forever) and non-idempotent migrations double-apply or `ConstraintError`.

**Deliverables in `/home/kara`:**
- `idb-atomic.mjs` — a 0-dependency `AtomicStore` wrapper (injectable factory, so it runs in browsers and under `fake-indexeddb`): a `tx()` runner that resolves only on `complete` and force-aborts every write on any failure, promise-based store/cursor helpers that keep transactions alive, an auto-installed `versionchange` handler that drains active transactions then closes (killing our own deadlock contribution), a coordinated `upgrade()` with a `BlockedError` deadlock-breaker, and `runTransient()` for idempotent retry of `AbortError`/`VersionError`.
- `test/atomic.test.mjs` — 18 deterministic tests covering: all-or-nothing rollback (request error, explicit `abort()`, thrown body error), cursor coherence and mid-set rollback, the **root-cause demos** (raw premature auto-commit splitting a write; async cursor stopping after 1 of 10), cross-connection atomic visibility, no-deadlock/no-data-loss across upgrades, `BlockedError` against a rogue tab, the same-version two-tab race (exactly one migrate), stale-reconnect `VersionError` recovery, and idempotent retry after a forced mid-txn abort (dirty write rolled back, converges exactly, no double-count).
- `SOLUTION.md` — title, full root-cause analysis with real bug snippets, the exact fix (design rules + key source), setup commands, and the verification mapping + actual `18 pass / 0 fail` and `ALL 5 RUNS GREEN` loop output.

**Verification:** `npm test` → 18/18 pass; `npm run test:loop` (5 consecutive full runs) → all green, confirming the tests are deterministic. Two notable environment findings the fix accounts for: `event.target.transaction` (not `event.transaction`) exposes the upgrade transaction in both browsers and fake-indexeddb, and a real-timer `await` inside `onupgradeneeded` deactivates the versionchange transaction, so migrations must be synchronous or microtask-only.
